introText:
Our library is built from what our leaders actually lead. Only a few questions are required, so write as much or as little as you like. We'll handle the formatting and follow up with any questions. You can submit several activities at once.

We can't publish lyrics for copyrighted songs. For those, we'll describe how to lead the song and link to a recording instead.
metaDescription: Lead a game, dance, or song that isn't in the ECRS activities library yet? Tell us how you lead it and we'll add it.
